get.description:
Returns a list of the number of tasks and calendar items per project for each day in the specified date range.
Tasks and calendar items whose start - finish overlap with the specified date range are included in the sums.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Beginning of date range to filter by.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: End of date range to filter by

parameters.name: limit_per_day
parameters.description: Number of results to return per day

parameters.name: project_owner_type_ids
parameters.description: Filter by project owner type IDs

parameters.name: sort_key
parameters.description: Sort results by a property of projects. Defaults to descending project_event_count.

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: Sort results in ascending or descending order

projects_count.description: Number of projects with tasks or calendar items on this day

projects.description: List of projects with counts of tasks or calendar items on this day. The size of this list is limited by the `limit_per_day` query parameter. The order of this list is determined by the `sort_key` and `sort_dir` query parameters.

items.description: Project with counts. `tasks_count` is only present if its value is greater than 0. `calendar_items_count` is only present if its value is greater than 0.

tasks_count.description: Number of tasks on this day

calendar_items_count.description: Number of calendar items on this day

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/schedule/summary?after=SOME_STRING_VALUE&before=SOME_STRING_VALUE&limit_per_day=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&project_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_stage_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_type_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_department_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_office_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_region_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_owner_type_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&program_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&resource_ids=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort_key=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort_dir=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
